name: exec
label: Execute Command
description: Execute shell commands on the host system. Supports background execution, timeouts, PTY mode for interactive CLIs, and environment variable injection.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds (kills process on expiry)

background.description: Run the command in the background immediately

pty.description: Run in a pseudo-terminal (PTY) for TTY-required CLIs

node.description: Node ID or name when host is 'node'

elevated.description: Run with elevated permissions on the host (if allowed)

security.description: Execution security mode (deny, allowlist, or full)

ask.description: Ask mode for exec approval (off, on-miss, always)
